description: Remove the sound track from an MP4, MOV, WebM or MKV video without re-encoding the picture (H.264, HEVC, VP9 or AV1). Returns an MP4. Can you run shell commands? Then do not send base64: upload the file from disk with curl -F file=@<path> https://helpyself.com/api/v1/tools/remove-audio-from-video (same tool, same answer, much faster). A HelpySelf tool (helpyself.com).

data.description: The video file (MP4, MOV, WebM or MKV), base64-encoded; a data: URL prefix is stripped. The picture must be H.264, HEVC, VP9 or AV1. The result comes back the same way in `data`, as an MP4. Send the whole file as it is, up to 20 MB: do not crop, shrink or split it first. If you can run shell commands, do not write the base64 out yourself: send the file from disk with curl -F file=@<path> -F <option>=<value> https://helpyself.com/api/v1/tools/remove-audio-from-video (add -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" if you have one); the answer is the same JSON.

name.description: The video's filename. The result is named after it, with -no-audio.mp4 on the end.

name: remove_audio_from_video
title: Remove Audio from Video
